coding_candidates.name: holdout_selected_seasonal_drift
coding_candidates.assumption: At least one lagged observation plus a robust cycle increment has lower recent holdout error than a local median.
coding_candidates.failure_condition: It should fail when no candidate lag improves the local-median holdout error, or when cycle increments vary sharply across adjacent cycles.

coding_candidates.name: validated_robust_damped_trend
coding_candidates.assumption: Recent median first differences predict near-future direction better than a local constant on historical holdouts.
coding_candidates.failure_condition: It should fail when rolling holdout error is no better than a constant forecast or when successive local slopes frequently reverse sign.

coding_candidates.name: validated_harmonic_ridge
coding_candidates.assumption: A trend-plus-harmonics fit predicts a withheld terminal block more accurately than the training-window median.
coding_candidates.failure_condition: It should fail when held-out cycles change phase, amplitude, or duration enough that harmonic error exceeds the median-baseline error.

coding_candidates.name: phase_specific_cycle_drift
coding_candidates.assumption: For lag 22, the median absolute circular first difference of the 22 phase increments is less than 0.40 times their median absolute magnitude, and the last-cycle shape correlation exceeds 0.90 after centering.
coding_candidates.failure_condition: It fails when the cycle length moves away from 22, adjacent phase increments become irregular, or a structural break makes the previous cycle unrepresentative.
